title: Can't make 2 cups in a row!
text:
Can't make 2 cups in a row!. I've had other 1 cup brewers and a Grinder & Brew types and you could easily make 2-3 cups in a row. Not with this one. After EACH cup, every removeable part requires cleaning! The grinder builds up a lot of grinds in the screen and must be cleaned and flushed. The lid for the grinder gets build up in nooks and crannies that are almost impossible to clean. The reusable filter needs cleaning and flushing. By the time you are ready to make another cup, the first cup is tepid! I don't know how it was possible for a company like Cuisinart to make such a ridiculous machine! My other grind and brew ground the beans and brewed the coffee and to make another cup, all that was required was to empty the reuseable filter and rinse and make another cup. It is such a hassle with the Cuisinart that it sits on the counter unused and waiting until I can get one of my old brands back.
I needed to revisit my review... Upon using this machine again two times, I found that even with brushes, it is nearly impossible to get the weird angles in the grinding and brewing components clean. Soaking won't do it and sponges can't clean it. Takes 5 minutes to make a cup of coffee, ten minutes to clean it properly for another cup.

features: Grinds & Brews up to 16 oz. at a time
Blade grinder automatically grinds whole beans and dispenses ground coffee directly into filter basket.
Simple controls are as easy as 1, 2, 3 - add beans, add water, press "Grind & Brew" button
Grind-off feature allows you to use pre-ground coffee
Removable drip tray accommodates travel mug, kindly refer the user manual given below for troubleshooting steps.
description: One cup brewing now offers fresh gourmet quality. This unit grinds beans first so every single cup gets the best of the bean for the best flavor. Use your favorite type of coffee for optimal results every time, so you're never disappointed. Making a delicious, fresh cup is as simple as 1-2-3, and dishwasher-safe, removable parts make cleaning just as easy. This is the single serve coffeemaker for folks who demand convenience and quality.
